{{Quote|However powerful, Vader is one, and we are many. No more debate. No more 'reflection.' No need of planning. Our prey comes to us. When he is dead, the Emperor will be crippled and know fear. And the galaxy will know the Jedi live.|Shadday Potkin|<ref name="SWP" />}}
'''Shadday Potkin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She would survive the war and the dissolution of the Order, only to be executed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in the following months.

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Shadday Potkin was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], Potkin had constructed a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to wield during her services to the Order. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Master Potkin took up the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and began sitting in on strategy reports at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="ROTS" />

When the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] issued [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to the Grand Army, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] dutifully turned their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] leaders. Potkin managed to evade execution and returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where she saw the Temple in ruins and her [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] comrades slain. While on the capital world, Master Potkin discovered that [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the man who ordered the dissolution of the Order and the new [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]], was indeed the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] the Order had been hunting.<ref name="R80">[[Republic 80|''Republic'' 80]]</ref>

[[File:PotkinDeath.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Potkin is killed by Darth Vader.]]

Leaving [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and going to ground, Master Potkin concocted a scheme to entrap Palpatine's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Calling a [[Jedi Convocation|conclave]] on the planet [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], Master Potkin's [[Conclave on Kessel|meeting]] would be held in an abandoned [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Mining/Legends|mine]]. As her peers showed up under the pretense that they would discuss the future of the Order, it became quite clear to all that Master Potkin was actually manipulating them for her own obsessive purpose. As her target, Darth Vader, stormed the complex and headed to Potkin's planned ambush, the other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] ignited their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in preparation of the surprise attack.<ref name="SWP" />

Numbering eight, Potkin and her allies attacked Vader. Armed with a rare [[Cortosis sword/Legends|cortosis blade]], Potkin was able to deactivate the Sith Lord's crimson-bladed weapon after he cut down [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Sia-Lan Wezz]]. Believing that she had the upper hand, Potkin's victory was quickly cut short when Vader simply grabbed her by the neck and snapped the woman's spine. Caught up in Potkin's plan, all six of the other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] present were killed.<ref name="SWP" />

==Personality==
[[File:ShaddayPotkin-SWCTP.png|thumb|150px|Shadday Potkin during the Clone Wars.]]
Potkin was an extremely arrogant woman, believing that she and other fellow Jedi would be able to conquer Vader despite the fact that he had already killed more Jedi by himself. In addition, she was naïve and self-absorbed enough to discount the fact that Vader was extremely powerful in the Force as well as the fact that he had far superior strength, leading to her death in her pride.<ref name="R80" />

==Behind the scenes==
Her name is from the designers of Dressing a Galaxy; Namely [[Usana Shadday]] and [[Noah Potkin]].<ref name="TCoSW">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref> She was portrayed by [[Aaliyah Williams]].
